definitions.gloss: state-owned land; land owned by the national government
definitions.explanation: Land whose owner is the national government rather than a private individual or company. Often discussed in the context of sales to the private sector, public projects, or administrative management.

examples.japanese: その{土地|とち}は{国有地|こくゆうち}だ。
{国有地|こくゆうち}は{原則|げんそく}として{自由|じゆう}に{売買|ばいばい}できない。
examples.english: State-owned land cannot, as a rule, be freely bought or sold.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}の{国有地|こくゆうち}が{民間|みんかん}の{企業|きぎょう}に{払|はら}い{下|さ}げられた。
examples.english: The state-owned land in front of the station was sold off to a private company.

notes:
Compound of {国有|こくゆう} (state-owned) + {地|ち} (land). Contrasts with privately held land.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国有地|こくゆうち}の{売却|ばいきゃく}: sale of state-owned land
- {国有地|こくゆうち}を{払|はら}い{下|さ}げる: to sell off state-owned land (to the private sector)
- {国有地|こくゆうち}の{管理|かんり}: management of state-owned land

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {私有地|しゆうち}: privately owned land — owned by an individual or company
- {公有地|こうゆうち}: publicly owned land — owned by a local government or public body
